items: 【Fabric Dresser with 12 Drawers】Say goodbye to messy spaces with this large dresser for bedroom. Measuring 70.8" x 13.8", the wide wooden top and 12 deep drawers (16.4" x 13.8") provide ample room for clothing, bedding, books, and gaming accessories. Perfect for bedrooms, living rooms, it keeps everything organized and within reach—no more digging through piles of clutter

【TV Stand for 80 Inch TV】Enjoy movie nights like never before! This storage dresser doubles as a TV stand with drawers for screens up to 80 inches, offering both style and function. Hide messy cords, DVDs, and gaming consoles in the spacious drawers for a clean, serene entertainment area where the whole family can relax and unwind

【Multi-Functional for Every Room】From living room, bedrooms to closets, or hallways, this large entertainment center adapts to your needs. Use it as a chest dresser, TV console, or entryway big dresser to maximize space and keep clutter under control. Its modern design seamlessly blends into any home décor, providing practical style wherever you need it

【Sturdy, User-friendly Design】Built with a durable wooden top, high-quality fabric drawers, and a sturdy metal frame, this rustic dresser is designed to last. The anti-tip kit ensures safety for families, while the smooth-glide drawers make it easy for little hands to access items. Plus, 8 adjustable feet keep it stable on uneven floors and protect your surfaces from scratches

【Easy Assembly】No stress, no hassle—this bedroom tv stand dresser comes with all parts and clear instructions, making assembly quick and easy in just 30 minutes. Lightweight yet durable, it’s easy to move and reposition, and you can organize your home effortlessly. Target Audience: Only for Adult
